purpose.domain_detail: Accounts Receivable debtor statements module for a South African ERP/accounting system (APAC). Prints debtor statements with ageing analysis, transaction history, and balance forward details.
purpose.summary: STMF03 is a batch debtor statements printing program for an accounts receivable system. It reads debtor master records, transaction history, and control files to produce formatted statements with ageing buckets (current, 1 month, 2 months, 3 months, interest). It supports printing statements for a range of debtor accounts and can create duplicate archive files (AR_Ayymm, AR_Tyymm).

notable_features: CRT STATUS / CURSOR IS / CONSOLE IS CRT (interactive screen support)
63 COPY statements for modular copybook architecture
COMP-3 packed decimal for GST rate
WS-CHECK field with encoded author name ('aeWlimemnomLalismJ')
Archive file naming AR_Ayymm/AR_Tyymm for copy statements
GNU GPL license notice embedded in SECURITY paragraph
